parameters.jsCode:
const f = $input.first().json;
const get = (k) => (f[k] || '').trim();

return [{ json: {
  propertyTitle: get('Property Title'),
  propertyType: get('Property Type'),
  transactionType: get('Transaction Type'),
  price: get('Price'),
  location: get('Location / Address'),
  area: get('Area (sq ft)'),
  config: get('Bedrooms / Configuration'),
  features: get('Key Features & Amenities'),
  builder: get('Builder / Society Name'),
  possession: get('Possession Status'),
  furnishing: get('Furnishing'),
  targetBuyer: get('Target Buyer Profile') || 'Families, working professionals, and investors',
  openHouseDate: get('Open House Date (if planned)'),
  ownerName: get('Owner Name'),
  ownerEmail: get('Owner Email'),
  ownerPhone: get('Owner Phone'),
  agentName: get('Agent / Broker Name'),
  agencyName: get('Agency Name'),
  agentPhone: get('Agent Phone'),
  agentEmail: get('Agent Email'),
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  dateGenerated: new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { year:'numeric', month:'long', day:'numeric' })
}}];

Configuration: ' + $json.config + '

Furnishing: ' + $json.furnishing + '
Target Buyers: ' + $json.targetBuyer + '

Generate this EXACT JSON:
{
  "portal_description_99acres": "Professional 200-word property description for 99acres/MagicBricks. Include all specs, amenities, location advantages. End with call-to-action.",
  "portal_description_short": "Crisp 50-word description for Housing.com or NoBroker style listing.",
  "portal_description_seo": "SEO-optimized 150-word description with keywords like buy/rent [config] in [location], [builder] [location] price, etc.",
  "instagram_caption": "Engaging Instagram post caption with emojis, property highlights, location tags, and call-to-action. Under 150 words. Include 15 relevant hashtags.",
  "instagram_story_text": "Short punchy text for Instagram story (under 30 words) with emoji and swipe up CTA.",
  "facebook_post": "Facebook marketplace style post. Detailed but conversational. Include all key details and CTA to contact.",
  "whatsapp_broadcast": "WhatsApp forward-friendly message. Formatted with emojis and line breaks. All key details. Under 200 words. End with agent contact.",
  "whatsapp_short": "Ultra-short WhatsApp message for quick sharing. Under 50 words with key specs and price.",
  "broker_pitch": "Professional email pitch to other brokers/channel partners offering this property for co-broking. Include commission mention. Under 150 words.",
  "neighbourhood_guide": "300-word neighbourhood guide covering: connectivity (metro, highway, airport distance), schools, hospitals, malls, restaurants, parks, upcoming development, why this location is great for the target buyer.",
  "open_house_invite": "Professional open house invitation with date, time, address, what to expect, RSVP details. Warm and inviting tone. Under 100 words.",
  "buyer_followup_email_1": "Follow-up email for interested buyer who visited or inquired. Warm, personal, includes property highlights and next step (site visit or call). Under 100 words.",
  "buyer_followup_email_2": "Second follow-up (5 days later) with urgency. Mention other interested parties. Offer to arrange another visit. Under 80 words.",
  "buyer_followup_email_3": "Final gentle follow-up (10 days later). No pressure. Leave door open. Under 60 words.",
  "comparison_points": ["5 key selling points that differentiate this property from competitors in the same area"],
  "objection_handling": [{"objection": "Common buyer objection", "response": "Professional response to overcome it"}],
  "price_justification": "3-4 sentences explaining why this property is priced right. Reference area rates, builder reputation, amenities value, appreciation potential.",
  "seo_keywords": ["20 SEO keywords for this property listing"],
  "target_audience_personas": [{"persona": "Buyer type", "age": "Age range", "income": "Income bracket", "motivation": "Why they would buy this", "where_to_find": "Where to target them (platform/location)"}],
  "owner_report_summary": "Professional 3-4 sentence summary for the property owner explaining what marketing has been activated and expected timeline for first inquiries."
}

IMPORTANT: All content must be specific to THIS property in THIS location. Use actual location names, nearby landmarks, and real area advantages. Write in Indian English. Prices in INR. Make WhatsApp messages forward-friendly. Return ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no backticks.' }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.7, maxOutputTokens: 8192 } }) }}
